description: An acute immune-mediated eruption characterised by distinctive targetoid lesions.
symptoms: Mucosal symptoms can occur in more extensive forms
causes: Often associated with infections such as herpes simplex; some cases are associated with medicines

appearance.general: Multiple round targetoid lesions, often with a dusky centre and concentric zones, may appear symmetrically on the extremities.

warning_signs: Mouth, eye, or genital mucosal involvement, extensive blistering, skin pain, or systemic illness requires urgent evaluation.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss recent infections, especially herpes simplex, and recent medicines.
